correctness.rationale: For any initial L2 datum the two block means obey an exact smooth planar ODE and the residual decays exactly as \(e^{-dt}\). On the polarized invariant line, \(\tanh z/z\) decreases, giving a unique nonzero branch for \(u>d/L_-\). The transverse block Jacobian eigenvalue is strictly negative because \(2z/\sinh(2z)<1\). Its common-mode eigenvalue changes sign once when \(\sinh(2z)/(2z)=L_+/L_-\), which is unique by an explicit derivative inequality and monotonicity of u(z). The entire transverse L2 complement has eigenvalue \(-d\); hence hyperbolic linearization gives the advertised full-space local stability and instability. The positive and negative consensus branches similarly have strictly negative Jacobian spectrum whenever present. The packaged checker verify.py was run successfully against four gains and the exact critical relation. No stability classification at equality is claimed.

value.rationale: The sharp formula separates stable polarized equilibria from merely existing polarized equilibria and shows simultaneous robust coexistence of two opposite consensus and two opposite polarization states under everywhere strictly positive social influence, contradicting an oversimplified consensus-only intuition. Exact dependence on \(a/b\) is naturally motivated by community cohesion and gives an analytically controlled boundary of graphon equilibrium approximations. This is not a routine normalization check, and it requires the full planar spectrum plus treatment of infinite-dimensional perturbations. Significance is mathematical, not an empirical prediction; only symmetric equal-mass two blocks and local stability are proved.
